policy.status: scope-only; processing and runtime support pending terrain pilot
policy.coordinateSpace: flat top-down material; renderer supplies isometric projection and clipping
policy.lighting: neutral unlit material; renderer retains day/night grading

candidates.name: Greenwood Vale ground
candidates.cues: Muted woodland-green ground with subtle brown soil, sparse fine grass and leaf-grain detail.

candidates.name: Flooded Marches ground
candidates.cues: Muted teal-green marsh earth with darker damp mud and restrained reed/grass grain. No puddles.

candidates.name: Ironroot Highlands ground
candidates.cues: Muted gray-green quarry earth with subdued dust and fine mineral grit.

candidates.name: Ashen Frontier ground
candidates.cues: Muted warm gray-brown ash/char earth with subdued grit and dry weathering. No embers.

candidates.name: Dark Crown ground
candidates.cues: Muted slate-violet earth with restrained fine mineral/obsidian grain. No purple glow.

candidates.name: Greenwood Vale road material
candidates.cues: Packed woodland-soil road, warm muted brown grain. Road margins, joints, wagon ruts and junctions stay in the renderer; do not bake them into the tile.

candidates.name: Flooded Marches road material
candidates.cues: Packed marsh/mud track, muted olive-brown fine grain. Road margins, joints, wagon ruts and junctions stay in the renderer; do not bake them into the tile.

candidates.name: Ironroot Highlands road material
candidates.cues: Weathered gray quarry-stone paving material, fine mineral grain. Road margins, joints, wagon ruts and junctions stay in the renderer; do not bake them into the tile.

candidates.name: Ashen Frontier road material
candidates.cues: Muted ash-brown wagon-road material, fine dry grain. Road margins, joints, wagon ruts and junctions stay in the renderer; do not bake them into the tile.

candidates.name: Dark Crown road material
candidates.cues: Ordered dark slate-violet paving material, fine stone grain. Road margins, joints, wagon ruts and junctions stay in the renderer; do not bake them into the tile.

candidates.name: Cliff/ravine stone face material
candidates.cues: Subdued gray-green stone-face grain and fine fracture texture. No drawn cliffs, ledges, silhouettes, perspective or cast shadows; existing exact barrier rims and fractures remain procedural.

candidates.name: Obsidian surface material
candidates.cues: Subdued dark violet-gray obsidian mineral grain; low contrast, no glowing veins or symbols. Existing rock/pool outlines stay procedural.

candidates.name: Lava crust material
candidates.cues: Subdued dark reddish-brown cooled crust grain. No glowing branching seams, cracks opening into new holes or light emission. Current hot seams and animated lava remain procedural overlays.

candidates.name: Wooden bridge timber grain
candidates.cues: Restrained weathered brown timber grain. No drawn plank boundaries, pins, rails, supports, bridge silhouette or baked perspective; grain aligns with the actual timber direction during integration.
